title: Asks you to send ID documents
why: Copies of your ID and a selfie are enough for scammers to open loan accounts or SIM cards in your name.
examples: Send a photo of your Aadhaar card and a selfie holding it to get the loan.
Please upload your PAN card and bank statement on WhatsApp to confirm the job.
safe: Do not share your Aadhaar copy with unknown people.
Your PAN card application has been received.
